title: Implement ed25519 operator signing and signature verification
description:
Implement signing of canonical article bytes with an operator ed25519 key (ed25519-dalek), and verification of those signatures. Artifact: src/signing.rs in usenet-ipfs-core. The signing key is never logged and never stored in plaintext in application state.

Acceptance:
- sign(key: &SigningKey, canonical_bytes: &[u8]) -> Signature compiles and works
- verify(pubkey: &VerifyingKey, canonical_bytes: &[u8], sig: &Signature) -> Result<()> works
- Unit test: sign then verify with same key passes
- Unit test: verify with wrong key returns error
- Unit test: verify with tampered bytes returns error
- No signing key material appears in any log statement
